newsitem.title: USA: PRESS DIGEST - Washington Post page one - March 3.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Washington Post page one - March 3.

text.p: The Washington Post carried the following stories on its front page on March 3:

LITTLE ROCK - At least 39 people were killed in several states as a storm system belted Arkansas with as many as 20 tornado touchdowns and dumped up to 10 inches of rain on parts of Kentucky and Ohio.

WASHINGTON - The care and feeding of wealthy contributors is an essential, if unseemly, component of presidential politics, but the Clinton administration's use of the White House to court and reward big donors goes far beyond what others have done in the past.
WASHINGTON - Home buyers are knocking on the District's door as sales and prices rebound after several down years.

CAMP DEMI, Bosnia - For all the recent publicity over problems between men and women in military bases in the United States, relations between the sexes in the field are easy going and untroubled, judging from a week spent with U.N. peacekeeping troops in Bosnia.

WARSAW - Five decades after Nazi hatred tore Europe apart and eight years after democracy broke the bonds of communism, generations of Poles are entering a new age of discovery and calling a hot line to find out the truth about their roots.
